title: Call For Paper
description: Conference seeks papers in all aspects of Soft Computing Techniques in Renewable Energy Systems and Smart Grid Technologies. Researchers, academicians, industry experts, and practitioners are invited to submit original research contributions related to intelligent energy systems and sustainable computing solutions.

tracks.title: Research Tracks
tracks.description: The conference invites submissions in all areas related to Soft Computing Techniques in Renewable Energy Systems and Smart Grid Technologies, including but not limited to the following tracks:

list.title: Smart Grid Planning and Operation
list.description: Soft computing techniques in smart grid planning and operation.

list.title: AI & ML for Energy Forecasting
list.description: AI- and ML-based load forecasting and renewable energy forecasting.

list.title: Power System Optimization
list.description: Optimization techniques for power system operation and control.

list.title: Demand Response and Energy Management
list.description: Demand response and demand-side management using intelligent methods.

list.title: Electric Vehicles and Charging Infrastructure
list.description: Electric vehicle integration and charging infrastructure optimization.

list.title: Energy Storage and Microgrids
list.description: Energy storage systems and microgrid management.

list.title: Cybersecurity and Smart Grid Protection
list.description: Smart grid protection, stability, and cybersecurity.

list.title: Hybrid Optimization Algorithms
list.description: Applications of PSO, GA, DE, ACO, SFOA, and other hybrid optimization techniques.

list.title: Deep Learning and Reinforcement Learning
list.description: Smart grid applications of deep learning and reinforcement learning.

list.title: Emerging Technologies and Future Trends
list.description:
• Quantum computing applications in energy systems
• Green hydrogen technologies
• AI-driven carbon neutrality solutions
• Internet of Energy (IoE)
• Smart energy markets and trading
• Digital transformation in power systems
• Future challenges in renewable energy and smart grids

list.title: Power Electronics and Intelligent Control Systems
list.description:
• Intelligent control of power converters
• Advanced inverter technologies
• Control strategies for renewable energy systems
• FACTS devices and smart grid applications
• Adaptive and robust control techniques
• Embedded systems for smart energy applications
• Automation in power systems

list.title: Internet of Things (IoT) and communication technologies in smart grids
list.description: IoT-enabled smart grids, communication protocols, sensor networks, and intelligent monitoring systems.

footer.title: Ready to Submit?
footer.description: Join researchers and innovators working towards sustainable energy systems, smart grids, and intelligent renewable energy technologies.
